title: This Deep-Sea Fish Has a See-Through Head With Rotating Eyes

scenes.text: This fish has a see-through head. Its eyes sit inside.
It's called the barreleye, and it lives about 2,000 feet down in the dark ocean.
Its eyes are tubes with bright green lenses.
For decades, scientists thought they were locked pointing upward.
In 2009, researchers filmed the eyes rotating inside the clear dome, so it can look up or turn forward to eat.
Nets had always destroyed that clear shield, so for decades nobody knew it existed.

description:
The barreleye fish has a fluid-filled, see-through head, and its eyes rotate inside it.
Researchers at the Monterey Bay Aquarium Research Institute filmed it about 2,000 feet deep.
What other secrets are hiding down there?
